buy_title: The pick: the Bissell Little Green, and the price to wait for
buy_total: The button shows today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Our price bands come from US retailers and deal threads on the dates named.
buy_kicker: Our top pick, and our last word

cards.name: Bissell Little Green (1400B)
cards.badge: Spot cleaner · the best-documented fall in price
cards.price: Walmart listed it at $78.97 on Nov 3, 2025 (Slickdeals); a Walmart brand page showed $95.99, was $124.99 (snapshot, undated). Buy under $90; it has gone lower before.
cards.buy_if: you have pets, kids, a couch or car seats, and you can wait for a sale: of everything here, this one has the clearest paper trail of a real cut in the Black Friday window.
cards.skip_if: you need whole-room carpet cleaning, or the sale price is above about $100 (it has been lower).
cards.owners: Reviewed.com found it easy to use and strong on tough stains but messy and poor on large areas. Walmart's page showed 4.4 out of 5 from about 1,600 reviews (snapshot, undated).
cards.video_title: 6 years with the Bissell Little Green — a long-term review

buy.pick: The Little Green 1400B (the basic model), not the ProHeat or HydroSteam, which are different machines at different prices
buy.check: Sold by Bissell, Amazon.com or a big-box store; the model number reads 1400B; bundles with extra tools are fine if the price is lower than the plain unit plus solution
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
cards.badge: Pressure cooker · buy on a doorbuster
cards.price: List $109.99 at Instant Pot's store. Past Black Friday doorbusters were about $50–$80, roughly 25–40% off (Business Insider guide, 2019; Slickdeals commenter, Mar 2025); 2025 retailer prices not found.
cards.buy_if: you want a plain pressure cooker for rice, beans and stews, and the price is 30–40% below list.
cards.skip_if: you want a slow cooker or air fryer first: America's Test Kitchen found the Duo slow-cooks poorly.
cards.owners: Walmart's listing showed 4.6 out of 5 from about 3,300 reviews (snapshot, undated). Owners fault the sealing ring that keeps odours and a few units that failed after about two years (Slickdeals, July 2025).
cards.video_title: Instant Pot DUO 6QT Full Review & First Look
cards.video_why: A review of the exact 6-quart size; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: Levoit Core 300-P Air Purifier
cards.badge: Air purifier · a bedroom buy, not a doorbuster
cards.price: Home Depot ran it near $49 (regional, $24–$99 by store) on Slickdeals threads dated Nov 6 and Nov 26, 2025; about $85–$100 at big retailers the rest of the time (Sept 2026).
cards.buy_if: you want one quiet bedroom purifier and can check a Home Depot store near you; $50–$60 is a fine price.
cards.skip_if: you want an open-plan room cleaned, or you will not budget for a filter every 6–8 months.
cards.owners: Owners praise the quiet sleep mode; iFixit users report a filter smell and a fan rattle. Levoit's warranty is two years.

cards.name: O-Cedar EasyWring Microfiber Spin Mop and Bucket
cards.price: Walmart $34.96, was $39.96 (Aug 20, 2026, Slickdeals); Costco has run a three-refill bundle near $26 (Slickdeals, July 2025).
cards.buy_if: you have sealed hard floors and want a pedal-wring mop; under $30 is a good price.
cards.skip_if: the pedal worries you: some Walmart reviewers report it breaking within a month, and the handle is a weak point.
cards.owners: Walmart reviewers praise dry floors and the easy wring; the pedal and handle are the repeated complaints. America's Test Kitchen named it its winning spin mop.
cards.video_title: O-Cedar EasyWring Microfiber Spin Mop Review & Demo
cards.video_why: A demo of the pedal wringer and the triangle head in use; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 185 (dual nozzle, non-electric)
cards.badge: Bidet attachment · stable price, small saving
cards.price: Walmart listed it at $42.49, was $48.99 (snapshot, undated); LUXE's store showed $49.99 in Oct 2026. Past Slickdeals threads show $20–$36 in 2021–2023.
cards.buy_if: you want the cheapest good bidet and can accept a saving of a few dollars: this one is always near its floor.
cards.skip_if: you hate cool water (look at the NEO 320) or your seat bolts fall outside 5.5–7.5 inches.
cards.owners: Walmart's listing showed 4.9 out of 5 from about 8,200 reviews (Oct 2026). A Slickdeals owner's unit leaked after about five years; the warranty is 18 months.

cards.name: Beckham Hotel Collection Bed Pillows (Standard/Queen, set of 2)
cards.price: Walmart listed a King two-pack out of stock with a $70 reviewer price (snapshot); Woot sold a pair at $34.99, was $49.99, in March 2023. Expect 30–40% bands, which also appear outside Black Friday.
cards.buy_if: you want soft guest-room pillows and will replace them in a year or two.
cards.skip_if: you are a heavy side sleeper (Consumer Reports' April 2026 picks include adjustable-loft pillows) or you want pillows that last for years.
cards.owners: TechRadar's tester found the gel fiber held its shape; Tom's Guide could not feel any gel. Check the listing is the gel-fiber set, not the memory-foam version.
cards.video_title: Beckham Hotel Collection Bed Pillows Review
cards.video_why: A first-look review that asks whether these suit side, back and stomach sleepers; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: Bedsure Heated Blanket Electric Throw (50 x 60 in)
cards.badge: Heated throw · check the model number
cards.price: Heated throws run about $20–$80 at major retailers; Walmart listed the U by Bedsure 50×60 at about $32 (Oct 1, 2026). Expect 30–45% off in a sale.
cards.buy_if: one person on a sofa wants a cheap heated throw and you check the label against the March 2023 CPSC recall before first use.
cards.skip_if: you want to cover a bed (a 50×60 in throw is too small) or any product with a recall history to explain.
cards.owners: Consumer Reports called Bedsure's flannel blanket the budget pick, thin but with the lightest wires; non-Amazon owner reviews were thin, so we cannot say how units hold up.

cards.name: Ninja AF101 4-Quart Air Fryer
cards.price: List $119.99; Best Buy, Target and Home Depot $89.99 (Slickdeals tracker, Apr 1, 2026). Home Depot showed 32% off Ninja kitchen appliances on Black Friday 2025 (NBC Select).
cards.buy_if: you want a small, simple air fryer for one or two people and it is at or under about $75.
cards.skip_if: you cook for a family (go to 6 quarts or more) or worry about nonstick wear: reports of peeling coatings on Ninja and Cosori baskets exist, though Ninja's are thin.
cards.owners: Walmart's listing showed 4.7 out of 5 from about 3,200 reviews for the Ninja 4-quart (snapshot, undated). America's Test Kitchen still ranks the Instant Vortex Plus 6-Quart first (Jan 2026).

cards.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
cards.price: List $499.99 (TechRadar). Target showed $349, Lowe's $242.29 on Oct 6, 2025 (Slickdeals), Walmart $379 (listing, undated). Expect 25–30% off; colours differ in price.
cards.buy_if: you bake often enough to use it weekly, and the price is near $250–$350.
cards.skip_if: you knead stiff dough often (owners report stalls on heavy dough and consumer testers favour the bowl-lift) or bake twice a year.
cards.owners: KitchenAid's own Best Buy Q&A answer says slight oil seepage can occur after sitting unused; heavy dough stalls the motor on Sam's Club reviews of the Artisan. America's Test Kitchen's mid-price pick is the Classic 4.5 qt.

cards.name: Cordless stick vacuum (Shark Cordless Pro, Dyson V8)
cards.badge: Stick vacuum · big cuts, battery risk
cards.price: Walmart showed Dyson V8 Absolute $349.99 and Shark Cordless Pro $198, was $399.99 (Black Friday roundups, 2025); Home Depot showed Shark 39% off (NBC Select, 2025).
cards.buy_if: you want a second vacuum for hard floors and quick jobs, and the price is a real 35–45% below list.
cards.skip_if: it is your only vacuum: Consumer Reports says it does not currently recommend cordless sticks for battery reliability (page date unconfirmed), and owners report dead batteries near two years.
cards.owners: Dyson Community and Slickdeals owners report batteries dying at about two years; Dyson lists a V6 battery at $129.99. Check the warranty, which is two years at Dyson.

cards.name: Tramontina 12-Piece Tri-Ply Clad Cookware Set
cards.price: Costco $189.99 in Oct 2025 (a $50 instant saving, about $240 normally; Slickdeals, Oct 23, 2025); Walmart $280 (Hunker, May 2026).
cards.buy_if: you want a full stainless set and can find it near $190–$200, which beat the Black Friday week in 2025.
cards.skip_if: you cook rarely: Cook's Illustrated's line is to skip sets and buy the pans you need, and owners report discolouration.
cards.owners: Walmart's listing showed 4.5 out of 5 from 439 reviews, with owners saying it stains easily; a Home Depot reviewer had food sticking on fry pans at six months. Nothing found on years-later condition.
